firmware.title: BK-0010/0011M
firmware.author: DnCraptor, konst-st and others
firmware.description: The Soviet BK-0010, BK-0010-01 and BK-0011M, PDP-11 home computers. AY and Covox sound, disk images and save states.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard, NES gamepad. Ctrl+F1-F8: save, Alt+F1-F8: load.
